'''Kazzak Hurn''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was the leader of the [[Fire-eaters]] that remained on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. When the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded Belsavis, Kazzak and the Fire-eaters were offered to work with the Empire and round up the other aliens.<ref name="TOR" />
